slash.name: Slash
slash.description: Animated weapon trails and sweeping attack arcs.

pointedStrike.name: Pointed Strike
pointedStrike.description: A long, centered blade tip with a clean directional finish.

heavyCleave.name: Heavy Cleave
heavyCleave.description: A thick arc with a long, heavy trail.

energySweep.name: Energy Sweep
energySweep.description: A bright palette with fast energy sparks.

shatteredEdge.name: Shattered Edge
shatteredEdge.description: A heavily broken edge with directional shards.

shape.label: Shape
shape.description: Define the arc silhouette, orientation, and perspective.

palette.label: Palette
palette.description: Build the radial color bands from the inner edge outward.

motion.label: Motion
motion.description: Control timing, trail length, and the direction of the sweep.

fragments.label: Fragments
fragments.description: Shape and animate debris released from the trailing edge.

breakup.label: Breakup
breakup.description: Control dissolve and outer-edge damage patterns.

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: Distance from the origin to the slash's outer edge.

thickness.label: Thickness
thickness.description: Width of the colored arc between its inner and outer edges.

tipLength.label: Tip length
tipLength.description: Length of the centered taper behind the leading edge; 100% spans about four times the slash thickness.

startAngle.label: Start angle
startAngle.description: Starting direction in screen space: 0° points right and 90° points down.

sweepAngle.label: Sweep angle
sweepAngle.description: Degrees travelled from the start angle; values above 360° create a second pass.

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotates the complete local slash path to aim the overall swing in screen space.

tilt.label: Perspective tilt
tilt.description: Compresses the slash plane; 90° produces the thinnest stable pixel projection.

sweepSpeed.label: Sweep speed
sweepSpeed.description: Higher values make the leading edge complete its path sooner.

trailLength.label: Trail length
trailLength.description: Delays the trailing edge so more of the arc remains visible.

dissolveMode.label: Dissolve mode
dissolveMode.description: How the trailing edge erodes pixels: ordered dither, clustered noise blocks, or streak-like tears.

edgeMode.label: Edge mode
edgeMode.description: How the outer edge breaks up: 2×2 chips, a jagged contour, or wedge-shaped slash cuts.

dissolve.label: Dissolve
dissolve.description: Length of the dissolution transition immediately ahead of the trailing edge.

edgeBreakup.label: Edge breakup
edgeBreakup.description: Intensity of outer-edge removal for the active edge mode.

breakupDepth.label: Breakup depth
breakupDepth.description: Maximum depth of edge breakup while preserving the core arc.

fragmentMode.label: Fragment mode
fragmentMode.description: How debris is drawn: square chunks, tangent-aligned shards, or fast short-lived sparks.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Amount of colored debris released as the trailing edge passes.

minSize.label: Minimum size
minSize.description: Smallest chunk width, shard line length, or spark trail length for the selected fragment mode.

maxSize.label: Maximum size
maxSize.description: Largest chunk width, shard line length, or spark trail length for the selected fragment mode.

tangentSpeed.label: Tangent speed
tangentSpeed.description: Motion along the direction of the sweep per animation cycle.

outwardSpeed.label: Outward speed
outwardSpeed.description: Motion away from the slash center per animation cycle.

lifetime.label: Lifetime
lifetime.description: Fraction of the animation for which detached fragments remain alive.

direction.label: Sweep direction
direction.description: Changes temporal travel along the same arc without flipping the rendered image.

paletteOrder.label: Palette order
paletteOrder.description: Bands are sampled directly on the pixel grid. No blended colors are introduced.

randomSeed.label: Random seed
randomSeed.description: Re-enter the same unsigned 32-bit value to reproduce breakup exactly.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.description: Physical fire, pressure release, rolling fire masses, and retro blasts.

body.label: Body
body.description: Pick the combustion silhouette and tune its geometry.

motion.label: Motion
motion.description: Control direction, formation, hold, and the motion curve.

material.label: Material
material.description: Choose the internal structure; legacy flat presets retain their surface and dissolve controls.

effects.label: Effects
effects.description: Toggle and tune flash core, shockwave, fire jets, and fragments.

palette.label: Palette
palette.description: Order discrete colors from the hot core to the dark edge.

shape.label: Body shape
shape.description: Choose a combustion silhouette; cards loop a fixed-seed preview.

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: Maximum radius of the centered fireball.

volume.label: Volume layering
volume.description: Build the body from rear heat, foreground fire, and occlusion seams.

volumeProfile.label: Internal structure
volumeProfile.description: Choose how heat, shell, and foreground fire are layered inside the body.

controls.fixedVolumeProfile: Internal structure: Smoke and fire (fixed by Smoke Burst).
controls.flatCompatibility: This preset uses the legacy flat renderer. Its surface controls remain available below.

churnAmount.label: Fire-mass expansion
churnAmount.description: Controls how strongly individual fire masses keep rolling outward after their staggered formation.

lobeCount.label: Fire-mass count
lobeCount.description: Number of overlapping fire masses forming the rolling fireball.

pressureCount.label: Shell count
pressureCount.description: Number of hard pressure wedges released around the flash core.

pressureWidth.label: Shell thickness
pressureWidth.description: Radial pixel thickness of each outward-moving shell plate.

pressureSharpness.label: Shell sharpness
pressureSharpness.description: How strongly each shell plate narrows toward its leading edge.

blastWidth.label: Blast width
blastWidth.description: Width of the connected pressure volume.

blastAngle.label: Blast angle
blastAngle.description: Direction of the short broad blast.

smokeSpread.label: Smoke spread
smokeSpread.description: Horizontal spread of the low smoke cloud.

smokeRise.label: Smoke rise
smokeRise.description: Upward travel applied independently to each smoke puff.

smokeCount.label: Smoke puff count
smokeCount.description: Number of main puffs packed into one connected, billowing smoke cluster.

smokeMotion.label: Smoke motion
smokeMotion.description: Choose rolling billows or a cloud that breaks into drifting pixel chunks.

shapeIrregularity.label: Shape irregularity
shapeIrregularity.description: Varies blob angle, size, and timing; zero produces a regular outline.

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotates the body, fire jets, and directional shock fronts together.

surfaceStyle.label: Surface material
surfaceStyle.description: Choose how the fire body is layered, sooted, or pixel-eroded.

dissolveStyle.label: Dissolve style
dissolveStyle.description: How retro pixels disappear once the dissolve starts.

dissolveSize.label: Circle size
dissolveSize.description: Radius of the round dissolve dots in pixels.

dissolveJitter.label: Scatter
dissolveJitter.description: How much the round dot centers shift off their grid.

dissolveDensity.label: Density
dissolveDensity.description: Spacing between round dissolve dots; higher spreads them apart.

dissolveSpeed.label: Dissolve speed
dissolveSpeed.description: How quickly the dissolve finishes after it starts.

coverage.label: Body integrity
coverage.description: Keeps more of the body geometry without changing the surface grain.

bandWarp.label: Band curvature
bandWarp.description: Bends burning layer boundaries with smooth low-frequency variation.

edgeBreakup.label: Edge breakup
edgeBreakup.description: Controls how unevenly burning layers erode inward from the silhouette.

sootAmount.label: Soot amount
sootAmount.description: Controls the bounded amount of dark rolling soot clouds.

sootScale.label: Soot scale
sootScale.description: Spatial scale of smooth soot clouds.

mode.label: Direction
mode.description: Outward explosion or inward implosion with mirrored timing.

motionCurve.label: Motion curve
motionCurve.description: Shapes how quickly formation and pressure release accelerate.

formationDuration.label: Formation time
formationDuration.description: Fraction of the animation used to reach full size.

holdDuration.label: Hold time
holdDuration.description: Fraction of the animation held at full size before dissolving.

dissolveStart.label: Dissolve time
dissolveStart.description: Point at which the body begins its defined breakup.

core.label: Flash core
core.description: Short-lived hot center flash at the impact end.

coreRadius.label: Core radius
coreRadius.description: Maximum radius of the enabled hot flash.

coreDuration.label: Core duration
coreDuration.description: Fraction of the animation occupied by the flash core.

shockwave.label: Shockwave
shockwave.description: A centered polar front that never perturbs the body outline.

shockwaveMode.label: Shockwave type
shockwaveMode.description: Disable the wave or choose a full ring or compound multi-ring; rings can be squashed.

shockwaveColorMode.label: Color mode
shockwaveColorMode.description: Flat single color or a radial gradient across each wave band.

shockwaveThickness.label: Thickness
shockwaveThickness.description: Radial band thickness of each wave ring.

shockwaveStartRadius.label: Start radius
shockwaveStartRadius.description: Wave start radius as a percentage of the body radius.

shockwaveEndRadius.label: End radius
shockwaveEndRadius.description: Wave end radius as a percentage of the body radius.

shockwaveStartTime.label: Start time
shockwaveStartTime.description: Point in the animation when the wave begins moving.

shockwaveDuration.label: Duration
shockwaveDuration.description: Fraction of the animation used to travel between the two radii.

shockwaveRingCount.label: Ring count
shockwaveRingCount.description: Number of complete rings that chase each other across the same path.

shockwaveRingSpacing.label: Ring spacing
shockwaveRingSpacing.description: Time stagger between consecutive rings; higher values spread them out.

shockwaveSquash.label: Squash amount
shockwaveSquash.description: Elliptical flattening along the squash axis for an impact feel.

shockwaveSquashAngle.label: Squash angle
shockwaveSquashAngle.description: Angle of the flattening axis in degrees.

tongues.label: Fire jets
tongues.description: Filled tapered flames launched from balanced body tips.

tongueCount.label: Jet count
tongueCount.description: Exact number of angularly balanced active flames.

tongueLength.label: Jet length
tongueLength.description: Maximum filled extension beyond each selected tip.

tongueWidth.label: Root width
tongueWidth.description: Width where each jet overlaps its owning body tip.

tongueCurvature.label: Curvature
tongueCurvature.description: Bounded sideways bend without changing jet distribution.

tongueVariation.label: Length variation
tongueVariation.description: Bounded deterministic length difference between selected jets.

fragments.label: Char fragments
fragments.description: Deterministic square debris flying outward or inward.

fragmentTravelDistance.label: Travel distance
fragmentTravelDistance.description: Distance fragments travel away from or toward the center.

fragmentTangentialDrift.label: Tangential drift
fragmentTangentialDrift.description: Sideways deviation from each fragment radial path.

fragmentLifetime.label: Lifetime
fragmentLifetime.description: Fraction of the animation in which fragments participate.

seed.label: Random seed
seed.description: Unsigned 32-bit value used to reproduce the same effect.

shapeDescriptions.rollingFireball: Overlapping fire masses roll outward as one connected explosion.
shapeDescriptions.shockBlast: A bright core drives separated short shell plates through angular gaps.
shapeDescriptions.smokeBurst: A low broad smoke mass expands around hot embers.
shapeDescriptions.legacyRadial: The original dense radial pixel explosion.

rollingFireball.name: Rolling Fireball
rollingFireball.description: Overlapping fire masses expand and cool on staggered schedules.

pressureBurst.name: Shock Blast
pressureBurst.description: Broad shell lobes release from a bright core.

smokeBurst.name: Smoke Burst
smokeBurst.description: A low broad smoke mass with restrained ember fragments.

particleSmokeBurst.name: Particle Smoke Burst
particleSmokeBurst.description: A smoke cloud that breaks into independently drifting pixel chunks.

retroBurst.name: Retro Burst
retroBurst.description: The original radial ring with dense per-pixel noise.

moltenCoreFireball.name: Molten Core Fireball
moltenCoreFireball.description: A dark shell with a persistent exposed molten core.

energyBloom.name: Energy Bloom
energyBloom.description: Petal, star, and corolla energy effects with vivid convergence.

body.label: Body
body.description: Pick the bloom shape and tune its size, outline, and surface material.

motion.label: Motion
motion.description: Control direction, formation, hold, and the motion curve.

material.label: Material
material.description: Choose the surface material and tune how it dissolves.

effects.label: Effects
effects.description: Toggle and tune flash core, shockwave, energy tongues, and shards.

palette.label: Palette
palette.description: Order discrete colors from the bright center to the deep outer edge.

shape.label: Bloom shape
shape.description: Choose a petal, star, or corolla silhouette; cards loop a fixed-seed preview.

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: Maximum radius of the centered bloom.

petalCount.label: Petal count
petalCount.description: Number of rounded petals around the shared center.

petalStretch.label: Petal stretch
petalStretch.description: Elongates each petal away from the shared center.

rayCount.label: Ray count
rayCount.description: Number of tapered star rays radiating from the center.

rayTaper.label: Ray taper
rayTaper.description: Sharper wedges as the value rises; lower values read as soft rays.

corollaLayers.label: Corolla layers
corollaLayers.description: Two or three staggered petal rings around the center.

layerDelay.label: Layer delay
layerDelay.description: Staggers each corolla layer; outer layers open later or close first.

shapeIrregularity.label: Shape irregularity
shapeIrregularity.description: Varies petal angle, size, and timing; zero produces a regular bloom.

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotates the body, energy tongues, and directional shock fronts together.

surfaceStyle.label: Surface material
surfaceStyle.description: Choose how the bloom body is banded, hollowed, cracked, or eroded.

dissolveStyle.label: Dissolve style
dissolveStyle.description: How retro pixels disappear once the dissolve starts.

dissolveSize.label: Circle size
dissolveSize.description: Radius of the round dissolve dots in pixels.

dissolveJitter.label: Scatter
dissolveJitter.description: How much the round dot centers shift off their grid.

dissolveDensity.label: Density
dissolveDensity.description: Spacing between round dissolve dots; higher spreads them apart.

dissolveSpeed.label: Dissolve speed
dissolveSpeed.description: How quickly the dissolve finishes after it starts.

coverage.label: Body integrity
coverage.description: Keeps more of the body geometry without changing the surface grain.

bandWarp.label: Band curvature
bandWarp.description: Bends cel-shaded band boundaries with smooth low-frequency variation.

edgeBreakup.label: Edge breakup
edgeBreakup.description: Controls how unevenly cel shading erodes inward from the silhouette.

cavityAmount.label: Cavity amount
cavityAmount.description: Controls the bounded amount of hollow molten regions.

cavityScale.label: Cavity scale
cavityScale.description: Spatial scale of smooth molten cavities.

chunkSize.label: Chunk size
chunkSize.description: Stable plate size used by the crystal shard surface.

crackWidth.label: Crack width
crackWidth.description: One- or two-pixel separation between crystal plates.

mode.label: Direction
mode.description: Outward bloom or inward convergence with mirrored timing.

motionCurve.label: Motion curve
motionCurve.description: Shapes how quickly formation and convergence accelerate.

formationDuration.label: Formation time
formationDuration.description: Fraction of the animation used to reach full size.

holdDuration.label: Hold time
holdDuration.description: Fraction of the animation held at full size before dissolving.

dissolveStart.label: Dissolve time
dissolveStart.description: Point at which the body begins its defined breakup.

core.label: Flash core
core.description: Short-lived bright center flash at the impact end.

coreRadius.label: Core radius
coreRadius.description: Maximum radius of the enabled flash.

coreDuration.label: Core duration
coreDuration.description: Fraction of the animation occupied by the flash core.

shockwave.label: Shockwave
shockwave.description: A centered polar front that never perturbs the bloom outline.

shockwaveMode.label: Shockwave type
shockwaveMode.description: Disable the wave or choose a full ring or compound multi-ring; rings can be squashed.

shockwaveColorMode.label: Color mode
shockwaveColorMode.description: Flat single color or a radial gradient across each wave band.

shockwaveThickness.label: Thickness
shockwaveThickness.description: Radial band thickness of each wave ring.

shockwaveStartRadius.label: Start radius
shockwaveStartRadius.description: Wave start radius as a percentage of the body radius.

shockwaveEndRadius.label: End radius
shockwaveEndRadius.description: Wave end radius as a percentage of the body radius.

shockwaveStartTime.label: Start time
shockwaveStartTime.description: Point in the animation when the wave begins moving.

shockwaveDuration.label: Duration
shockwaveDuration.description: Fraction of the animation used to travel between the two radii.

shockwaveRingCount.label: Ring count
shockwaveRingCount.description: Number of complete rings that chase each other across the same path.

shockwaveRingSpacing.label: Ring spacing
shockwaveRingSpacing.description: Time stagger between consecutive rings; higher values spread them out.

shockwaveSquash.label: Squash amount
shockwaveSquash.description: Elliptical flattening along the squash axis for an impact feel.

shockwaveSquashAngle.label: Squash angle
shockwaveSquashAngle.description: Angle of the flattening axis in degrees.

tongues.label: Energy tongues
tongues.description: Filled tapered ribbons launched from petal or star tips.

tongueCount.label: Tongue count
tongueCount.description: Exact number of angularly balanced active tongues.

tongueLength.label: Tongue length
tongueLength.description: Maximum filled extension beyond each selected tip.

tongueWidth.label: Root width
tongueWidth.description: Width where each tongue overlaps its owning tip.

tongueCurvature.label: Curvature
tongueCurvature.description: Bounded sideways bend without changing tongue distribution.

tongueVariation.label: Length variation
tongueVariation.description: Bounded deterministic length difference between selected tongues.

fragments.label: Energy shards
fragments.description: Deterministic diamond shards flying outward or inward.

fragmentTravelDistance.label: Travel distance
fragmentTravelDistance.description: Distance shards travel away from or toward the center.

fragmentTangentialDrift.label: Tangential drift
fragmentTangentialDrift.description: Sideways deviation from each shard radial path.

fragmentLifetime.label: Lifetime
fragmentLifetime.description: Fraction of the animation in which shards participate.

seed.label: Random seed
seed.description: Unsigned 32-bit value used to reproduce the same effect.

shapeDescriptions.softPetals: Rounded cartoon petals that open outward.
shapeDescriptions.layeredCorolla: Staggered petal layers opening in sequence.
shapeDescriptions.arcaneBurst: A bright controlled energy shell without petals.

softPetals.name: Soft Petals
softPetals.description: Rounded cartoon petals with cel bands; tongues are off by default.

sharpStarburst.name: Sharp Starburst
sharpStarburst.description: Controlled tapered star rays with a crystalline surface.

layeredCorolla.name: Layered Corolla
layeredCorolla.description: Two staggered petal layers that open in sequence.

arcaneBurst.name: Arcane Burst
arcaneBurst.description: A bright controlled energy shell without petals.

softPetalsImplosion.name: Soft Petals Implosion
softPetalsImplosion.description: Rounded petals collapse inward onto a closing flash.

starburstImplosion.name: Starburst Implosion
starburstImplosion.description: Sharp star rays converge into the center from the rim.

corollaImplosion.name: Corolla Implosion
corollaImplosion.description: Staggered corolla layers close inward, outer layer first.

projectile.name: Projectile
projectile.description: Seamless flight loops for fireballs and magic arrows.

body.label: Body
body.description: Pick the projectile body, size, and baked facing.

motion.label: Motion
motion.description: Control loop cycles, pulsing, and gentle bobbing.

trail.label: Trail
trail.description: Choose a fire or energy band trailing behind the body.

effects.label: Effects
effects.description: Toggle sparks and afterimages and tune their behavior.

palette.label: Palette
palette.description: Color the solid arrow body and every energy surface.

kind.label: Projectile
kind.description: Fireball or magic arrow sharing the same centered anchor.

arrowMaterial.label: Arrow material
arrowMaterial.description: Solid metal body or a pure energy silhouette with a crisp edge glow.

radius.label: Size
radius.description: Body radius in pixels; the flight loop stays centered.

bodyLength.label: Body length
bodyLength.description: Length of the directional body; arrows use the full value while fireballs use it as elongation.

silhouetteVariation.label: Silhouette variation
silhouetteVariation.description: Deterministic lumpiness of the fireball or arrow outline.

fireRearExtension.label: Rear flame reach
fireRearExtension.description: Extends only the fireball rear toward its comet root.

fireRearTurbulence.label: Rear turbulence
fireRearTurbulence.description: Strength of the animated low-frequency rear contour.

fireFlowSpeed.label: Heat flow speed
fireFlowSpeed.description: Speed of the fireball's internal color circulation.

fireMottleAmount.label: Surface mottling
fireMottleAmount.description: Sparse color-band variation drifting through the fireball middle and rear.

solidHeadLength.label: Arrowhead length
solidHeadLength.description: Portion of the solid arrow reserved for its pointed head.

solidShaftWidth.label: Shaft width
solidShaftWidth.description: Thickness of the solid arrow's central shaft.

solidFletchingSpread.label: Fletching spread
solidFletchingSpread.description: Width of the solid arrow's rear feathers.

energyCoreLength.label: Energy core length
energyCoreLength.description: Length of the bright inner spear core.

energyShellWidth.label: Energy shell width
energyShellWidth.description: Extra width of the dark outer energy shell.

energyTipSharpness.label: Energy tip sharpness
energyTipSharpness.description: Moves the diamond's widest point toward a sharper or broader tip.

crystalSpearTaper.label: Crystal taper
crystalSpearTaper.description: Sharpness of the spear's faceted ends.

crystalSpearThickness.label: Crystal thickness
crystalSpearThickness.description: Cross-section thickness of the crystal spear.

crystalRefractionStrength.label: Refraction strength
crystalRefractionStrength.description: Contrast between the crystal's lit and shaded planes.

crystalGlintStrength.label: Glint strength
crystalGlintStrength.description: Brightness and coverage of the crystal's moving surface glint.

crystalGlintSpeed.label: Glint speed
crystalGlintSpeed.description: Speed of the surface glint along the crystal axis.

crystalCoreScale.label: Core scale
crystalCoreScale.description: Size of the central crystal nucleus.

crystalOrbitRadius.label: Orbit radius
crystalOrbitRadius.description: Distance of satellite shards from the crystal core.

crystalOrbitSpeed.label: Orbit speed
crystalOrbitSpeed.description: Satellite rotation speed within the seamless loop.

rotation.label: Baked rotation
rotation.description: Rotates body, trail, sparks, and afterimages together.

loopCycles.label: Loop cycles
loopCycles.description: Whole pulse and wobble cycles per loop for a seamless repeat.

pulseAmount.label: Pulse
pulseAmount.description: How strongly the body breathes during each loop cycle.

wobbleAmount.label: Wobble
wobbleAmount.description: Gentle perpendicular bobbing around the centered anchor.

trailMode.label: Trail
trailMode.description: Off, a flickering fire band, or an undulating energy band.

trailLength.label: Trail length
trailLength.description: How far the band extends behind the body rear.

trailWave.label: Trail wave
trailWave.description: Lateral wave traveling along the band.

trailBreakup.label: Trail breakup
trailBreakup.description: Deterministic holes scattered through the band.

sparks.label: Sparks
sparks.description: Flickering debris released behind the body.

sparkSpread.label: Spark spread
sparkSpread.description: How far sparks scatter sideways from the flight path.

sparkSpacing.label: Spark spacing
sparkSpacing.description: Radial distance between the nearest and farthest sparks.

sparkFade.label: Spark fade
sparkFade.description: Fraction of sparks drawn smaller as they recede.

afterimages.label: Afterimages
afterimages.description: Ghost copies trailing the body along the flight path.

afterimageCount.label: Afterimage count
afterimageCount.description: Number of ghost copies behind the body.

afterimageDecay.label: Afterimage decay
afterimageDecay.description: How quickly copies shrink toward the darkest palette color.

randomSeed.label: Random seed
randomSeed.description: Re-enter the same unsigned 32-bit value to reproduce the effect exactly.

solidArrow.label: Solid arrow
solidArrow.description: A physical arrow with a metal body.

energyArrow.label: Energy arrow
energyArrow.description: A pure energy silhouette with a bright edge.

crystalCore.label: Crystal core
crystalCore.description: A floating crystal nucleus with orbiting facets.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: A pulsing fireball with a flickering flame trail and sparks.

blastBolt.name: Blast Bolt
blastBolt.description: A compact fire projectile with a broad broken wake and strongly advected sparks.

enchantedArrow.name: Enchanted Arrow
enchantedArrow.description: A solid magic arrow wrapped in an energy trail.

energyArrow.name: Energy Arrow
energyArrow.description: A pure energy arrow with a crisp edge glow and wide spark spread.

crystalSpear.name: Crystal Spear
crystalSpear.description: A faceted crystal spear with drifting shards and a short refracted wake.

crystalCore.name: Crystal Core
crystalCore.description: A floating crystal nucleus orbited by stable faceted shards.
